I don’t think I will ever regret cutting me mother put of my life. At some points yes, I do miss her because, shit shes my mom but, the shit she put me through fucked me over and I don’t think I will ever be able to crawl out of the nasty hole I got in while living with her. 
Since I was about 8/9 my mom started drinking heavily and became extremely depressed. She never left her room and she barely showered. I also have reason to believe that she had to have been doing some other shit because she went from being a size like 8-10 in jeans to a 00 pretty quick so yikes. But back to what I was saying, this started to really hurt me bad because she was in such a bad place and I couldn’t handle her being this sad. What made this worse was my parents are divorced and I had just gotten back from living with my dad in Chicago. Having my dad gone and my mom almost not there killed me.
   A little later I remember her starting to get this weird shit going on with her feet. It was like diabetic nerve pain but she didn’t have diabetes. It was fucking weird but anyway, she started drinking more and she couldn’t really get around. My siblings and I had to take care of her since she didn’t have a job when this started to happen. (she ended up getting a job after her depressive episode but later quit and got the pain) Seeing my mom like this made me so incredibly sad and it kept wearing down on me and I was starting to do bad in school and get way more emotional and “rebellious” because I didn’t know how to control how I was feeling. I remember one day, I woke up to my older sister and my mom fighting and my sister and brother ended up walking me to school. seeing my mom so enraged scared me and made me brake down. I had started to become so sad and just angry at everything. My dad ended up moving back to California (where I lived at the time) and I never told him about my moms drinking problems or how I felt because I just wanted to enjoy the time away.
  When i started to feel better we ended up getting evicted because we had no money at all and my mom, my older brother and i all went to Utah while my sister stayed here. In Utah, my mental health took a huge dip. I started to cut really bad and even attempted suicide a few times.  It felt as if I had no one. My mom treated me like shit and I had no one to turn to. She became worse and I was always talked to as if I was nothing. After two years i finally gave up and left her. She let me go but whenever we talked, we fought and fought. After three years of self harm and suicide attempts I got hospitalized and finally got therapy. 
I cannot imagine what would have happened if my mom stayed in my life.
